description: List public holidays of a country (and optionally a state/region) for a year, with English and local names and substitute (observed) days. 200+ countries. Use for scheduling across countries, shipping cut-offs, payroll or market-closed days. Set types to include bank/optional/observance days.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, DE, JP, IN, AE

region.description: Optional state/region code, e.g. CA (California) for US, BY (Bavaria) for DE. Regional holidays differ.

name: world_list_holidays
